exporters.help:
Usage: rer run --script ./oncall-export.mjs opsgenie|pagerduty
Uses the Oncall installer’s runtime; requires rer and an interactive terminal. Prompts for us/eu region, UTC comparison dates (1–31 days), and a hidden read-only API key.
GET requests only; no packages or uploads. Collects all accessible records, follows pagination and joins schedule details/overrides.
Saves PROVIDER-export-DATE-TIME.json in the current folder only after collection, credential removal and the 512 KiB/500-object checks succeed.
Upload that file under Settings → Move in → Other: from a file → Review. Paging stays OFF.

compatible.sample:
: "${ONCALL_SOURCE_KEY:?Set ONCALL_SOURCE_KEY privately first}"
key_json=$(printf '%s' "$ONCALL_SOURCE_KEY" | od -An -v -tx1 | awk 'BEGIN{printf "\""} {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) printf "\\u00%s",$i} END{printf "\""}')
curl --fail-with-body 'http://127.0.0.1:46231/v2/enqueue' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-binary '{"event_action":"trigger","dedup_key":"receiver-check","payload":{"summary":"Service latency is above normal","source":"Oncall receiver check","severity":"warning"},"routing_key":'"$key_json"'}'

: "${ONCALL_SOURCE_KEY:?Set ONCALL_SOURCE_KEY privately first}"
curl --fail-with-body 'http://127.0.0.1:46231/v2/alerts' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: GenieKey $ONCALL_SOURCE_KEY" \
  --data-binary '{
  "alias": "receiver-check",
  "message": "Service latency is above normal",
  "priority": "P3"
}'

: "${ONCALL_SOURCE_KEY:?Set ONCALL_SOURCE_KEY privately first}"
key_path=$(printf '%s' "$ONCALL_SOURCE_KEY" | od -An -v -tx1 | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) printf "%%%s", $i}')
curl --fail-with-body 'http://127.0.0.1:46231/integrations/generic/20131114/alert/'"$key_path"'/oncall' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-binary '{
  "entity_id": "receiver-check",
  "entity_display_name": "Service latency is above normal",
  "message_type": "WARNING"
}'

checkpoint.output:
Private local paired recovery checkpoint; paging remains OFF.
Usage: rer run --script scripts/checkpoint.mjs --origin URL --session-file FILE COMMAND

  export NEW_FILE [--version 1|2]   Capture one consistent checkpoint (default v2)
  restore FILE --replace           Explicitly replace coordination and scheduling
                                   (v2 also restores reviewed handoffs)
  --admin-mapping MEMBER_ID        Restore-only; explicit empty-target mapping
  --help                          No authentication or network

Origin must be HTTP loopback, without credentials/path/query/fragment. Redirects
are refused. Session file must be owned, regular, mode 0600, with no hard links.
It contains a held oncall_session_PORT cookie/token or the installation's local Base
session cookie and optional port-bound dev gate; all are retained after restores.
Never put credentials in arguments, environment variables or shell history.
Exports use new mode-0600 files; existing files are refused. Restore serializes
access to the session file, keeps it unchanged on server refusal, and replaces
it privately with the successful rotated session. See docs/checkpoints.md for
recovery after interrupted transport or local file failure. Server validation,
current-admin checks, atomic replacement and mapping rules are authoritative.
No login, provider, account, delivery or paging action is performed.
